Resolutions of 2009

48 resolutions, 92% unanimous. Terror, robust peacekeeping, thematic agendas.

  • 1860 (2009) A durable and fully respected ceasefire and the full withdrawal of Israeli forces from the Gaza Strip
  • 1861 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in the Central African Republic and Chad (MINURCAT)
  • 1862 (2009) The settlement of the border dispute between Djibouti and Eritrea and withdrawal of Eritrean forces from the area of conflict
  • 1863 (2009) Renewal of the authorization of member States of the African Union to maintain the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM)
  • 1864 (2009) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Mission in Nepal (UNMIN)
  • 1865 (2009) Renewal of the mandates of the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI) and of the French forces which support it
  • 1866 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Georgia (UNOMIG)
  • 1867 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Mission in Timor-Leste (UNMIT)
  • 1868 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA)
  • 1869 (2009) Designation of Valentin Injko as the High Representative for the Implementation of the Peace Agreement in Bosnia and Herzegovina
  • 1870 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in the Sudan (UNMIS)
  • 1871 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO)
  • 1872 (2009) Renewal of the authorization of the African Union to maintain the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM)
  • 1873 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP)
  • 1874 (2009) Measures against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in connection with its nuclear weapon tests
  • 1875 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF)
  • 1876 (2009) Extension of the mandate of UN Peacebuilding Support Office in Guinea-Bissau (UNOGBIS) and the establishment of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Guinea-Bissau (UNIOGBIS)
  • 1877 (2009) Extension of the terms of office of permanent and ad litem judges to the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and on amending art. 14 of the Statute of the International Tribunal
  • 1878 (2009) Extension of the terms of office of permanent and ad litem judges to the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) and on amending art. 13 of the Statute of the International Tribunal
  • 1879 (2009) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Mission in Nepal (UNMIN)
  • 1880 (2009) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI) and of the French forces which support it
  • 1881 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the African Union-United Nations Hybrid Operation in Darfur (UNAMID)
  • 1882 (2009) Children and armed conflict
  • 1883 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI)
  • 1884 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL)
  • 1885 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL)
  • 1886 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Sierra Leone (UNIPSIL)
  • 1887 (2009) Nuclear non-proliferation and nuclear disarmament
  • 1888 (2009) Sexual violence against women and children in situations of armed conflict
  • 1889 (2009) Women and peace and security
  • 1890 (2009) Extension of the authorization of the International Security Assistance Force in Afghanistan (ISAF)
  • 1891 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Security Council Resolution 1591 (2005)
  • 1892 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH)
  • 1893 (2009) Extension of measures imposed by Security Council resolutions 1572 (2004) and 1643 (2005) on sanctions against Côte d'Ivoire and extension of the mandate of the UN Group of Experts
  • 1894 (2009) Protection of civilians in armed conflict
  • 1895 (2009) Authorization of the Member States to establish a Multinational Stabilization Force (EUFOR) as a legal successor to Stabilization Force (SFOR) in Bosnia and Herzegovina
  • 1896 (2009) Expansion of the mandate of the Committee Established pursuant to resolution 1533 (2004) and extension of measures on arms, transport, financial and travel against the Democratic Republic of the Congo imposed by resolution 1807 (2008)
  • 1897 (2009) Acts of piracy and armed robbery against vessels in the waters off the coast of Somalia
  • 1898 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP)
  • 1899 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF)
  • 1900 (2009) Extension of the terms of office of permanent and ad litem judges to the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and on temporarily amending art. 12, para. 1, of the Statute of the International Tribunal
  • 1901 (2009) Extension of the terms of office of trial judges at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) and on temporarily amending art. 11, para. 1 of the Statute of the International Tribunal
  • 1902 (2009) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Office in Burundi (BINUB)
  • 1903 (2009) Extension of travel ban on persons deemed to be a threat to the peace in Liberia and readjustment of the arms embargo
  • 1904 (2009) Continuation of measures imposed against the Taliban and Al-Qaida
  • 1905 (2009) Extension of the arrangements for depositing into the Development Fund for Iraq of proceeds from export sales of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas
  • 1906 (2009) Extension of the deployment of the UN Organization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUC)
  • 1907 (2009) Arms embargo against Eritrea and on expansion of the mandate of the Security Council Committee Established pursuant to Resolution 751 (1992)
